mapper.select: select distinct #{YES_NO_N,jdbcType=VARCHAR} as innovation, pdi.prd_design_id as planningSeriesNo, pdi.prd_design_serial_name as planningSeriesName, TEMP1.initialPlanningValue AS initialPlanningValue, TEMP.RenewahShare/10000 as productsDue from PRODUCT_DESIGN_INFO pdi left join (select sum(bpp.tdy_share_amt/10000 ) as initialPlanningValue,fpa.prd_design_id prd_design_id from BOK_POSITION_PRD bpp left join FIN_PRODUCT_ADD fpa on fpa.finprod_id=bpp.finprod_id and bpp.branch=0 AND to_char(bpp.CDATE, 'yyyy-MM-dd') = #{baseDate} group by fpa.prd_design_id) TEMP1 on TEMP1.prd_design_id = pdi.prd_design_id left join (select sum(CASE WHEN dfpdt.ps in (#{PS_QZ,jdbcType=VARCHAR},#{PS_CPRG,jdbcType=VARCHAR},#{PS_CPSG,jdbcType=VARCHAR},#{PS_CPHLTZ,jdbcType=VARCHAR}) then dfpdt.share_amt else (-1*dfpdt.share_amt) end ) RenewahShare,fpa1.prd_design_id prd_design_id from TRD_FIN_PRODUCT_DEAL_TOTAL dfpdt left join FIN_PRODUCT_ADD fpa1 on dfpdt.finprod_id = fpa1.finprod_id where dfpdt.is_cancel= #{YES_NO_N,jdbcType=VARCHAR} and dfpdt.trade_status= #{JYZT,jdbcType=VARCHAR} and dfpdt.busi_type in (#{SYS_YQSYX,jdbcType=VARCHAR},#{SYS_JZX,jdbcType=VARCHAR},#{SYS_HBX,jdbcType=VARCHAR}) AND dfpdt.TRADE_DATE <= to_date(#{planningStartDate}, 'yyyy-MM-dd') and dfpdt.ps in (#{PS_QZ,jdbcType=VARCHAR},#{PS_CPRG,jdbcType=VARCHAR},#{PS_CPSG,jdbcType=VARCHAR},#{PS_CPSH,jdbcType=VARCHAR},#{PS_CPTQSH,jdbcType=VARCHAR},#{PS_CPDQ,jdbcType=VARCHAR},#{PS_TQZZ,jdbcType=VARCHAR},#{PS_FEQJ,jdbcType=VARCHAR},#{PS_CPWYSH,jdbcType=VARCHAR},#{PS_CPHLTZ,jdbcType=VARCHAR}) group by fpa1.prd_design_id) TEMP on TEMP.prd_design_id = pdi.prd_design_id

select A.PRD_PLAN_CODE planningNo, A.BENCH_DATE baseDate, A.VDATE planningStartDate, A.EDATE planningEndDate, A.REMARK remarks, B.PRD_PLAN_SERIS_ID planningSeriesNo, B.PRD_PLAN_SERIS_NAME planningSeriesName, B.PLAN_INIT_AMT/10000 initialPlanningValue, B.PLAN_CHANGE_AMT/10000 planningChangeValue, B.PLAN_TARGET_AMT/10000 planningTargetValue from PRD_PLAN_INFO A left join PRD_PLAN_DETAIL B on A.PRD_PLAN_CODE = B.PRD_PLAN_CODE where 1=1
AND A.BENCH_DATE = to_date(#{baseDate}, 'yyyy-MM-dd')
AND A.VDATE = to_date(#{planningStartDate}, 'yyyy-MM-dd')
AND A.EDATE = to_date(#{planningEndDate}, 'yyyy-MM-dd')
AND (B.prd_plan_seris_id IN
null) or B.prd_plan_seris_id IN (
#{item} )

select temp.prd_plan_seris_id id, temp.prd_plan_seris_name text from( select distinct prd_plan_seris_id, prd_plan_seris_name from PRD_PLAN_DETAIL t where 1=1
AND ( t.prd_plan_seris_id LIKE CONCAT('%', CONCAT(#{search}, '%')) OR t.prd_plan_seris_id LIKE CONCAT('%', CONCAT(#{search}, '%')) )
union select t1.PRD_DESIGN_ID as prd_plan_seris_id, t1.PRD_DESIGN_SERIAL_NAME as prd_plan_seris_id from PRODUCT_DESIGN_INFO t1 where 1=1
AND ( t1.PRD_DESIGN_ID LIKE CONCAT('%', CONCAT(#{search}, '%')) OR t1.PRD_DESIGN_SERIAL_NAME LIKE CONCAT('%', CONCAT(#{search}, '%')) )
) temp
select A.BENCH_DATE baseDate, A.VDATE planningStartDate, A.EDATE planningEndDate, A.PRD_PLAN_CODE planningNo, A.remark from PRD_PLAN_INFO A where A.PRD_PLAN_CODE = #{planningNo,jdbcType=VARCHAR}

select B.IS_NEW innovation, B.PRD_PLAN_SERIS_ID planningSeriesNo, B.PRD_PLAN_SERIS_NAME planningSeriesName, B.PLAN_INIT_AMT/10000 initialPlanningValue, B.PLAN_CHANGE_AMT/10000 planningChangeValue, B.PLAN_TARGET_AMT/10000 planningTargetValue from PRD_PLAN_DETAIL B where B.PRD_PLAN_CODE = #{planningNo,jdbcType=VARCHAR}
select A.BENCH_DATE benchDate, A.TARGET_SCALE targetScale from ASSET_PLAN_INFO A where to_char(A.VDATE,'yyyy-MM-dd')=#{planningStartDate} and to_char(A.EDATE,'yyyy-MM-dd')=#{planningEndDate}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO PRD_PLAN_INFO (PRD_PLAN_CODE, BENCH_DATE, VDATE, EDATE, REMARK, CREATE_USER, CREATE_DEPT, CREATE_TIME, UPDATE_USER, UPDATE_TIME) VALUES( #{planningNo,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{baseDate,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{planningStartDate,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{planningEndDate,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{remark,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{createUser,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{createDept,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{planningStartDate,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{updateUser,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{planningEndDate,jdbcType=VARCHAR} )
